scope: Reference Range-to-distance endpoints consumed by actual projectile impacts

sources.notes: RangeFormula plus get_ads_multiplier; default Auto Rifle 1.6 and default Hand Cannon 1.5. These factors are not weapon zoom.

policies: Range clamps to 0..100 before the start and end curves. Each accepted fire captures both calculation traces, minimum multiplier and ready-ADS distance multiplier.
Distance is the Euclidean separation between captured launch position and observed collision point, not current owner position, target center or accumulated ricochet path.

The external weapon_falloff_shape test profile is explicitly synthetic linear interpolation between the published endpoints; the archived Foundry source supplies endpoints/floors, not an independently verified damage interpolation function.
The ready-only ADS threshold is a Chorus policy; original transition interpolation, range sampling, ricochet distance and all family/exotic exceptions remain uncalibrated.
remaining: Full weapon/exotic range catalog and actual damage interpolation calibration
